name: Frigate NVR Explorer
description: Native Frigate NVR camera viewer with live streams, events & reviews browser, clip playback with detection boxes, and recording timeline scrubbing for Kiosk Satellite.
author: tibohlami

settings.title: Frigate Server URL
settings.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL of your Frigate NVR server (e.g. port 5000 or authenticated port 8971)

settings.title: Frigate Username
settings.description: Optional username for authenticated Frigate (port 8971) automatic login

settings.title: Frigate Password
settings.description: Optional password for authenticated Frigate (port 8971) automatic login

settings.title: Bearer Token / JWT
settings.description: Optional manual token override (leave empty if using username/password or port 5000)

settings.title: Accept untrusted SSL certificates
settings.description: Allow self-signed or invalid HTTPS certificates for local Frigate servers (e.g. port 8971). Enable only on trusted local networks.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Plugin language ('Default' uses the tablet's default language)

settings.title: UI Scale Factor
settings.description: Scale factor for wall tablets (1.0 = standard, 1.35 = recommended large, 1.6 = extra large)

settings.title: Show stream transport badge
settings.description: Display a small pill in the player header indicating the active stream mode (HLS, MP4, MSE, MJPEG)

settings.title: Show object bounding boxes by default
settings.description: Enable the detection bounding-box overlay by default during event and history playback

settings.title: Object box time offset (s)
settings.description: Time shift in seconds for detection bounding boxes if they lag behind (+) or lead (-) the recorded video. Typically +1.0s to +2.5s depending on camera keyframe interval (GOP) and detect/record stream latency.

settings.title: Mute audio by default
settings.description: Start live streams and recorded clips muted when opening the player

buttons.title: Test connection
buttons.label: Connect
buttons.description: Verify server URL, SSL certificate, authentication, and Frigate API access.

buttons.title: Frigate Explorer
buttons.label: Open
buttons.description: Show the Frigate Explorer panel on the kiosk.
